raw_comment: I noticed that the Midwest part of the U.s is suffering from any drought, and I wonder if it could be because the Midwest is far from oceans. I also wonder if climate change is associated with the drought levels in these states. However, there are some states that have abnormal droughts, but are located near oceans. I wonder why this is and if climate change is associated with the high droughts as well. My question is if these droughts are only temporary, of if they will continue on in the future.
